thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: PD#INF-9082 - inference queue backlog above critical threshold for inference-hotpath in us-west-2. Current queue depth: 42,800.
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-9082 created and routed to @oncall-jordan. Escalation policy: on-call -> sre-lead -> infra.
oncall-jordan: I'm on call, looking. Initial checks: autoscaler target desired=40, current nodes=12, pods pending scaling.
eng-arya: Seen spike around 14:32 UTC, many short requests but KV cache warmup is thrashing, prefix cache miss rate ~78%. Queue growth started ~14:28.
sre-kim: Checking autoscaler loop logs. Saw repeated failures: "failed to create node: quotaExceeded" and "provider API rate limit" around 14:30. Could be hitting cloud quota or API throttling.
eng-raj: Confirming cloud console: node pool quota at 100/100, cannot increase. Also some provisioning attempts timed out: kube-provisioner 504s.
oncall-jordan: Customer impact? product-ana, any known user reports?
product-ana: Zooming in on support dashboard — a handful of customers report timeouts on generate endpoints; error rate up ~9% and p95 latency >10s for hosted customers in us-west-2. Not widespread yet but trending.
ops-mike: If quota is the blocker, we can temporarily shift traffic to us-east-1 region via routing policy until scaled capacity comes up. That requires model routing change and maybe fallbacks to lower-capacity model variants.
eng-arya: Quick mitigation options: 1) manual node spin-up (if quota freed), 2) re-route new requests to us-east-1 (risk: cross-region latency), 3) enable degraded-mode that switches to smaller model variant (resolves capacity at cost of quality).
sre-kim: Trying manual scale: running: kubectl annotate deployment inference-hotpath alpha/allow-manual-scale=true && ./scripts/manual-scale --pool hotpath --replicas 20
eng-raj: Manual scale returned error: {"error":"quotaExceeded","message":"Requested CPUs exceed quota"}. Cloud support ticket opened, but ETA unknown.
oncall-jordan: OK let's enact traffic shift plan. Steps: update routing policy to prefer us-east-1 for new sessions, keep existing sessions in us-west-2. Eng-arya, please prepare canary route.
eng-arya: Preparing canary: will route 20% of new sessions to us-east-1 with model-variant=v1-small. Patch to routing table:

PATCH /routing/policies/hotpath
- add rule: region_preference: [us-east-1, us-west-2]
- canary: 20% -> model_variant: v1-small

Applying now.
eng-raj: Applied routing change, 20% of new sessions flowing to us-east-1. Monitoring queue depth... new incoming queue for us-east-1 showing 420 requests, processing fine.
product-ana: Notifying support: sending note to customers in affected region with mitigation message.
eng-arya: Also enabling degraded-mode fallback for non-critical routes: config set inference.hotpath.degraded=true
sre-kim: Watch CPU/latency metrics. p95 in us-west-2 still high but growth rate slowed after routing change. Queue depth in us-west-2 decreased from 42.8k -> 28.4k over 6 mins.
incident-bot: Note: PD-9082 acknowledged by oncall-jordan at 14:36 UTC.
oncall-jordan: Handing to SRE lead for follow-through and long-term fix; will remain available for context. @sre-kim take it.
sre-kim: Taking over. Next actions: coordinate with infra to request temporary quota increase, maintain routing canary, monitor for regression. Also open runbook task to audit autoscaler retry/backoff logic to avoid hammering provider API.
eng-raj: Opening cloud support case CS-77219 with priority high; included logs and provisioning timestamps.
ops-mike: If cloud quota ETA > 30m, propose increasing canary to 50% and rolling more sessions to us-east-1 until capacity restored. Thoughts?
product-ana: Approve canary increase to 50% for 20m trial, notify customers first.
sre-kim: I'll bump to 50% in 2 mins and monitor error rates.
eng-arya: Increased canary to 50%. Now 50% new sessions to us-east-1 with v1-small. Observability: overall error rate dropped to 3%, p95 latency back under 6s.
incident-bot: PD-9082 update: mitigation in progress, traffic shifted, degraded-mode enabled; incident severity downgraded to sev-2 for continued monitoring.
oncall-jordan: Thanks team. I'll sign out of primary on-call; leaving handoff note in PagerDuty and ops runbook.
sre-kim: Will keep this incident open until quota increase confirmed and autoscaler backfills queue. Next update in 15m or sooner on regressions.
eng-raj: Logged retrospective action items: (1) cloud quota monitoring alert, (2) autoscaler backoff improvements, (3) model-variant routing automation playbook.
product-ana: I'll draft customer follow-up note once we confirm full recovery.
ops-mike: Good job everyone. :thumbsup:
